The tantalizing aroma of mushrooms and butter beckons you to the table.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Mushroom Risotto can be made by [[Cooking]] any [[Mushroom]], [[Hylian Rice]], [[Goat Butter]], and [[Rock Salt]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. The default version of Mushroom Risotto can only be made either by using [[Hylian Shroom]]s, which offer no status effects, or by using multiple Mushrooms with differing effects. When eaten, some [[Heart]]s will be restored to [[Link]]. The smell of the Mushrooms and butter in this [[Meal]] draws people to eat. [[Ivee's Diary]], which can be found in her home in [[Hateno Village]], details a recipe for Mushroom Risotto.{{Cite|Today's Recipe:
{{Color BotW|Blue|Mushroom Risotto}}|Ivee's Diary|BotW}} [[Ivee]] lists the Ingredients as one bundle of Hylian Rice, one serving of Goat Butter, a few Hylian Shrooms, and a little bit of Rock Salt.{{Cite|Ingredients:
{{Color BotW|Blue|Hylian Rice}} (one bundle)
{{Color BotW|Blue|Goat Butter}} (one serving)
{{Color BotW|Blue|Hylian Shrooms}} (approximately a few)
{{Color BotW|Blue|Rock Salt}} (exactly "a little")|Ivee's Diary|BotW}} She also notes that the Hylian Shrooms can be substituted for a [[Hearty Salmon]], which would result in [[Salmon Risotto]].{{Cite|Note: Use a {{Color BotW|Blue|hearty salmon}} instead of {{Color BotW|Blue|Hylian shrooms}} for a fish-lover's dish!|Ivee's Diary|BotW}} Several different kinds of Mushrooms can be used when making Mushroom Risotto, which can result in the following variations: * '''Chilly Mushroom Risotto''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Mushroom Risotto}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
The tantalizing aroma of mushrooms and butter beckons you to the table.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Chillshroom]]s or other chilly [[Ingredient]]s. If eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. * '''Electro Mushroom Risotto''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Mushroom Risotto}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
The tantalizing aroma of mushrooms and butter beckons you to the table.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Zapshroom]]s or other electric Ingredients. When eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Mushroom Risotto''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Mushroom Risotto}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
The tantalizing aroma of mushrooms and butter beckons you to the table.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Endura Shroom]]s or other enduring Ingredients. Link's [[Stamina Wheel]] will be completely replenished and overfilled by eating these. * '''Energizing Mushroom Risotto''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Mushroom Risotto}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
The tantalizing aroma of mushrooms and butter beckons you to the table.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Stamella Shroom]]s or other energizing Ingredients. Eating them will replenish part of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Hasty Mushroom Risotto''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Mushroom Risotto}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
The tantalizing aroma of mushrooms and butter beckons you to the table.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Rushroom]]s or other hasty Ingredients. If eaten, Link's movement speed will be increased. * '''Hearty Mushroom Risotto''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Mushroom Risotto}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
The tantalizing aroma of mushrooms and butter beckons you to the table.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hearty Truffle]]s, [[Big Hearty Truffle]]s, or other hearty Ingredients. These meals will heal all of Link's Hearts and temporarily increase his maximum Hearts. * '''Mighty Mushroom Risotto''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Mushroom Risotto}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
The tantalizing aroma of mushrooms and butter beckons you to the table.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Razorshroom]]s or other mighty Ingredients. Consuming these meals will boost Link's attack power. * '''Sneaky Mushroom Risotto''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Mushroom Risotto}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
The tantalizing aroma of mushrooms and butter beckons you to the table.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Silent Shroom]]s or other sneaky Ingredients. Link's [[Stealth]] can be increased by eating these. * '''Spicy Mushroom Risotto''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Mushroom Risotto}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
The tantalizing aroma of mushrooms and butter beckons you to the table.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Sunshroom]]s or other spicy Ingredients. They grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]] when consumed. * '''Tough Mushroom Risotto''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Mushroom Risotto}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The tantalizing aroma of mushrooms and butter beckons you to the table.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Ironshroom]]s or other tough Ingredients. Eating them will grant Link a boost to his [[Defense]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Noble Canteen Poster.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}The recipe for Chilly Mushroom Risotto, as displayed at The Noble Canteen ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Risottos |items= BotW, TotK }}
